Hand-painted 2D game item illustration, crisp exaggerated LARGE facet planes, deep colored lower side planes, subtle brush texture, restrained warm white highlights at the upper left, rich luminous stone body but not neon. Strong silhouette and readable value contrast, a slight three-quarter tilt giving volume. No photorealistic macro photography, no jewelry advertising, no transparent glass blandness, no flat vector look. Gem itself fills about 76 percent of a square canvas with empty transparent margins on all sides. No setting, no frame or border, no text or runes, no pedestal, no background, no huge halo, no secondary objects. One object only, actual transparent alpha. Subject: a broad square emerald-cut emerald with clipped corners, a large flat top table and stepped facets, deep forest green, a strong square silhouette.
